videos.title: Vision-based source seeking: illustrative 3D replay
videos.type: illustrative rendering, not an experimental video

mode_history.explanation: The first trace sample at t=0 is after the initial jump. The two startup holds show pre-jump and post-jump states at t=0; no simulated time is added.

videos.renderer: scripts/replay-renderer.js; native browser canvas, shared first-scene artwork and solid rover geometry
videos.appearance: The same detailed ground texture, natural boulder, blue solid rover, and supplied gray camera drone as the interactive setup. A square orthographic inset uses the matching fixed world footprint. Objects are illustrative and not the Isaac Sim experimental robot. A separate lightly washed-out local crop isolates short exploratory strokes; the fixed full overhead scene stays visible.
videos.rendering: Original 0.02 s capture-time positions and estimates, plus exact terminal sample. Thicker high-contrast paths; an equal-axis local crop displays the preceding 0.60 s. All views use one continuous clock with 32x overview and a 0.125x slow-motion interval at recorded seconds 100–102. Heading = heading0+2*pi*sqrt(omega)*capture_s/T. Mode follows initial_mode and jump events. No coordinate amplification, smoothing, gain changes or new experiment. Fast overview aliases rapid oscillations; slow motion retains the saved sampling resolution.

scientific_interface.field_access: Independent scalar signal at the true plant position; only geometry and switching use the estimated position. No field gradient is supplied to the oscillatory control.
scientific_interface.reference: A source-aligned reference direction is specified a priori per configuration.
scientific_interface.scaling: physical position [m] = L * position [workspace units], L=0.5; t_seconds=T*tau, T=80.
scientific_interface.heading: heading0 + 2*pi*sqrt(omega)*t_seconds/T; recover from the controller clock, never from the path tangent.
scientific_interface.no_shift: The selected records use field_offset=0 and directly apply the original additive potential; no extra J-star phase shift is inserted.
scientific_interface.arrival: 0.125 m source neighborhood held for 8 s, horizon 3200 s; preserve original terminal samples.

visual_style.disclosure: Illustrative terrain/rock/rover artwork and author-supplied drone. These are rendering overlays, not new camera observations or a new perception evaluation. The displayed nonholonomic heading follows the recorded controller clock, not the path tangent.

local_detail.heading_arrow: Same controller-derived heading as the 3D robot; arrow length is a display annotation.

input_checks.scope: Numerical input checks for this finite record; not a proof of scalar-input persistent excitation for arbitrary trajectories.

videos.estimation: Synthetic bounded error: 0.005*[cos(0.1*t),sin(0.1*t)] at 0.02 time-unit intervals; applied-input prediction between updates.
videos.reason: Illustration parameters chosen to show the reference figure’s wider repeated exploration: omega=100, gamma=12, kappa=0.6, rho_o=1, quadratic field coefficient 0.1. The original Vq construction and input law are retained, but these are not the paper’s experimental settings. The positions are directly integrated, never multiplied for display.
videos.scope: A separate qualitative simulation. Not a CAP measurement, not a paper cohort trial, not a reproduction of the static figure data, and not a new CAP or Isaac Sim evaluation.
videos.title: Nonholonomic source seeking — visible exploration parameters
videos.scene: Both backgrounds replay one numerical trajectory. Wide oscillations come from the listed controller/field parameters. Both full scenes remain visible throughout, with fixed marked-region insets at equal x/y scale. Global paths show all past samples; insets show the preceding 0.04 model seconds, retaining the labeled t=0.850 view afterward. Playback slows from video seconds 16 to 26 without replacing either scene.

videos.title: Holonomic robot — growing recorded trajectory
videos.selection: Fixed single-expert run whose initial position is closest to (0,-3) among 50 archived cases; lowest trial index breaks ties.
videos.rendering: At each completed image update, append the paired original ground-truth and visual-observation coordinates. Connect successive pairs without interpolating a future endpoint. Initial car icons remain fixed. Both backgrounds replay the same observation pairs. The original higher-rate ground truth and held controller estimates are included in the download.
videos.heading: No rotation. Initial-position icons are schematic and do not depict the evolving heading.
videos.scope: Historical single-expert trial, not a CAP evaluation or the exact run in the supplied static PDF. This view compares paired positions at image updates, not the held controller estimate between updates. The original full trace is preserved. The excerpt does not replace a full-run result or certify the current paper dwell criterion.

scene.background: Illustrative overlay, not inference camera frames

comparison.basis: Paired ground truth and visual observations at every recorded image update; connecting segments join only completed updates.
comparison.inter_update_values: The original zero-order-held controller estimate is retained in original-run.npz and controller-held.csv; it is not presented as a fresh camera observation.

videos.title: Nonholonomic robot — growing recorded trajectory
videos.selection: Primary CAP C2 (core_0_0_3), omega=1600; same frozen record as the C2 supplementary replays.

base.source_reference: Exact a priori source-side direction; direction is declared design information, not inferred online.

videos.rendering: Starts without trajectory lines; past recorded samples and interpolated current endpoints are progressively drawn. Car icons stay at the initial position with fixed orientation. Both panels replay the same record.
videos.heading: No rotation. Initial-position icons are schematic and do not depict the evolving heading.
videos.scope: Recorded original-Vq CAP run; illustrative backgrounds, not newly captured camera frames. Not the exact run in the supplied static PDF. The 0.2 s trace sampling does not resolve every high-frequency oscillation.

scene.background: Illustrative overlay, not inference camera frames

potential_verification.signal_access: Scalar measurement at the true plant position; geometry evaluated at the predicted position.
potential_verification.heading: heading0 + 2*pi*sqrt(omega)*tau; integrated in physical position coordinates, equivalent to the chart pushforward by the chain rule
potential_verification.time_and_length_scaling: Controller normalized time tau=t_s/80; displayed meters=0.5*workspace units. Video axes use workspace units and clock uses recorded seconds.
potential_verification.scope: Algebra and recorded switching-gap verification; not a new closed-loop experiment or a stability proof.
